confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Home Assistant will be able to change this TV's overlay position, size, style, auto-hide, and auto-listen. It will not start the microphone, change the login, or install updates.

abort.no_id: The TV did not identify itself. Turn Home Assistant layout off and on in Kellie's Voice, then try again.
abort.use_discovery: Open Kellie's Voice on the TV and turn on Home Assistant layout. Leave the app open. This integration then shows up here as a discovered device.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Show a short text announcement on one configured TV, or on every configured TV when no device id is given. This does not start the microphone.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the message stays up, from 1 to 120 seconds.

device_id.name: TV device id
device_id.description: One configured TV. Leave empty to send to every configured Kellie's Voice TV.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Ask a configured TV to open a Home Assistant camera entity. This does not start the microphone or send a stream URL.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: A camera entity, such as camera.front_door.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the popup stays up, from 1 to 120 seconds.

device_id.name: TV device id
device_id.description: One configured TV. Leave empty to send to every configured Kellie's Voice TV.
